name: @workspace/host-agent
description: Cloud Gaming Platform — Windows host agent (Electron). Captures the configured game window and streams it to a remote player over WebRTC, injecting their keyboard/mouse input via the Windows SendInput API.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.test: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer && node --test test/ping-server.test.mjs test/*.test.mjs
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/fetch-vigem-dll.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
